legend: The teacher gave Anton a large geometry homework, but he didn't do it (as usual) as he participated in a regular round on Codeforces. In the task he was given a set of n lines defined by the equations y = ki·x + bi. It was necessary to determine whether there is at least one point of intersection of two of these lines, that lays strictly inside the strip between x1 < x2. In other words, is it true that there are 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n and x', y', such that:
y' = ki * x' + bi, that is, point (x', y') belongs to the line number i;
y' = kj * x' + bj, that is, point (x', y') belongs to the line number j;
x1 < x' < x2, that is, point (x', y') lies inside the strip bounded by x1 < x2.
You can't leave Anton in trouble, can you? Write a program that solves the given task.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100 000) — the number of lines in the task given to Anton. The second line contains integers x1 and x2 ( - 1 000 000 ≤ x1 < x2 ≤ 1 000 000) defining the strip inside which you need to find a point of intersection of at least two lines.

The following n lines contain integers ki, bi ( - 1 000 000 ≤ ki, bi ≤ 1 000 000) — the descriptions of the lines. It is guaranteed that all lines are pairwise distinct, that is, for any two i ≠ j it is true that either ki ≠ kj, or bi ≠ bj.
output: Print "Yes" (without quotes), if there is at least one intersection of two distinct lines, located strictly inside the strip. Otherwise print "No" (without quotes).
note: In the first sample there are intersections located on the border of the strip, but there are no intersections located strictly inside it.

legend.ai: 老师给了 Anton 一份很大的几何作业，但他没有完成（像往常一样），因为他参加了 Codeforces 的一场常规比赛。在这道题中，他得到了一组由方程 y = ki·x + bi 定义的 n 条直线。需要判断这两条直线是否至少存在一个交点，其横坐标严格位于 x1 < x2 所确定的条带内部。换句话说，是否存在 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n 以及 x'、y'，使得：
y' = ki * x' + bi，即点 (x'，y') 属于编号为 i 的直线；
y' = kj * x' + bj，即点 (x'，y') 属于编号为 j 的直线；
x1 < x' < x2，也就是说，点 (x', y') 位于由 x1 < x2 所界定的条带内部。
你不能对 Anton 的困境置之不理，对吧？请编写一个程序解决给定的问题。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，交点位于条带的边界上，但不存在严格位于条带内部的交点。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 100 000），表示题目中给出的直线数量。第二行包含整数 x1 和 x2（ - 1 000 000 ≤ x1 < x2 ≤ 1 000 000），它们定义了一个条带，你需要在该条带内部找到至少两条直线的交点。
接下来的 n 行包含整数 ki、bi（ - 1 000 000 ≤ ki, bi ≤ 1 000 000），表示这些直线的描述。保证所有直线两两不同，即对于任意两个 i ≠ j，都有 ki ≠ kj 或 bi ≠ bj。

output.ai: 如果至少存在一个两条不同直线的交点严格位于条带内部，则输出 "Yes"（不含引号）。否则输出 "No"（不含引号）。
